benchmarks.label: LIBERO
benchmarks.detail: Suites: libero spatial 98.7 · libero object 99.7 · libero goal 98.6 · libero long 94.2 | Table 1 and Table 5 | Notes: Generalist setting; a single model jointly trained across LIBERO, SimplerEnv, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa-GR1 datasets.

benchmarks.label: SimplerEnv
benchmarks.detail: Suites: WidowX 65.2 · Google-VA 69.8 · Google-VM 74.3 | Table 1 and Table 5 | Notes: Generalist setting. Overall is the mean of the three paper-reported SimplerEnv suite aggregates because the paper does not report a single SimplerEnv average.

benchmarks.label: RoboTwin 2.0
benchmarks.detail: Suites: clean* 88.7 · random* 87.8 | Table 1 and Table 5 | Notes: Generalist setting. Asterisk indicates both clean and random data are used for training. Overall uses the paper-reported random* aggregate over RoboTwin 2.0 tasks; the paper does not report a clean-only Generalist score.

benchmarks.label: RoboCasa-GR1
benchmarks.detail: Suites: average over 24 RoboCasa-GR1 tasks 57.3 | Table 1 and Table 5 | Notes: Generalist setting; a single jointly trained model improves over the Specialist StarVLA-α RoboCasa-GR1 score.

benchmarks.label: RoboChallenge
benchmarks.detail: Suites: ARX5 standard 11-task set average success rate 33.6 | Tasks: arrange flowers 40.0 · arrange paper cups 20.0 · fold dishcloth 0.0 · open the drawer 20.0 · place shoes on rack 50.0 · put cup on coaster 100.0 · search green boxes 60.0 · sort electronic products 20.0 · turn on light switch 50.0 · water potted plant 10.0 · wipe the table 0.0 | Table 7 | Notes: Public real-world RoboChallenge evaluation as a Generalist; table also reports progress score 54.5, but overall stores success rate.
